info.name: JamBase Concert Data Artists Geographies API

params.name: page
params.description: Page number of results to retrieve

params.name: perPage
params.description: Number of events per page of results

params.name: geoCityName
params.description:
Use to retrieve events for city name(s).
- geoCityName=Seattle

Use a pipe (|) to include multiple city names.
- geoCityName=Seattle|Tacoma

For more precise city-specific results try using `city[id]`

params.name: geoCountryIso2
params.description:
The two-letter ISO code for a country.
- geoCountryIso2=US

Use a pipe (|) to include multiple countries.
- geoCountryIso2=US|CA

params.name: geoCountryIso3
params.description:
The three-letter ISO code for a country.
- geoCountryIso3=USA

Use a pipe (|) to include multiple countries.
- geoCountryIso3=USA|CAN

params.name: geoIp
params.description:
Use to retrieve events near an IP address.\
Supports IPv4 or IPv6 values.
- geoIp=55.123.456.789

params.name: geoLatitude
params.description:
The latitude for geographic radius.
- geoLatitude=40.7505

params.name: geoLongitude
params.description:
The longitude for geographic radius.
- geoLongitude=-73.9934

params.name: geoMetroId
params.description: Use to retrieve events for specific metro ID(s). - geoMetroId=jambase:1 Use a pipe (|) to include multiple metro IDs. - geoMetroId=jambase:1|jambase:5

params.name: geoRadiusAmount
params.description:
The search radius for lat/lng type searches.
- geoRadiusAmount=60

params.name: geoRadiusUnits
params.description:
Whether to use miles (default) or kilometers for radius.
- geoRadiusUnits=km

params.name: geoStateIso
params.description:
The State code in ISO_3166-2 format [[docs](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-2)].
- geoStateIso=US-NY

Use a pipe (|) to include multiple State codes.
- geoStateIso=US-NY|=US-PA

Note: Available for United States, Canada, and Australia only.

params.name: cityHasUpcomingEvents
params.description: Only include Cities with / without upcoming events. Omit for both.

items.docs:
Search for cities. Results will be returned in order of most to least upcoming events in the city, and then alphabetically city name in the case of a tie.       

<!-- theme: info  -->
> #### Requirement
> Your request must include at least one of the geo parameters such as `geoCityName`, `geoCountryIso2`, `geoCountryIso3`, `geoIp`, `geoMetroId`, `geoStateIso`, or `geoLatitude` and `geoLongitude`.

params.name: metroHasUpcomingEvents
params.description: Only include Metros with / without upcoming events. Omit for both.

params.name: cityHasUpcomingEvents
params.description: Only include Cities with / without upcoming events. Omit for both.

params.name: expandMetroCities
params.description: Use `true` to include the `containsPlace` node with the cities for each metro.

items.docs:
A Metro is a collection of Cities, such as the Los Angeles area which includes LA, Hollywood, Anaheim, and more that can be used to filter Events.\
\
Returns all Metros in Alphabetical order by identifier.

params.name: stateHasUpcomingEvents
params.description: Only include States with / without upcoming events. Omit for both.

params.name: geoCountryIso2
params.description:
The two-letter ISO code for a country.
- geoCountryIso2=US

Use a pipe (|) to include multiple countries.
- geoCountryIso2=US|CA

params.name: geoCountryIso3
params.description:
The three-letter ISO code for a country.
- geoCountryIso3=USA

Use a pipe (|) to include multiple countries.
- geoCountryIso3=USA|CAN

items.docs:
A States (or Region / Province) is a collection of Cities, such as California (USA) or Quebec (Canada) that can be used to filter Events.\
\
Returns all States/Regions in Alphabetical order by identifier.
\
Note: Available for United States, Canada, and Australia only.

params.name: countryHasUpcomingEvents
params.description: Only include Countries with / without upcoming events. Omit for both.

items.docs: Returns all Countries in alphabetical order by ISO2.
